confidence_notes: Restaurant and café anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge of Istrian coastal pricing in July peak season, and are moderately reliable. Hostel and hotel anchors are less certain because July rates vary widely by availability and booking lead time. FX provenance is weaker than the price estimates: the 0.6955 figure was relayed in a search summary attributed to the RBA homepage, but I did not independently verify it on the RBA page, and third-party sites show slightly different mid-October values (about 0.6947).
comparable_city_reasoning: Estimated against Istrian and Dalmatian coastal resort towns with similar July tourism demand (for example Rovinj, Poreč, Zadar and Split), adjusted to Pula's mid-sized urban prices. Croatia uses the euro, so the USD anchors reflect euro-area prices converted at approximate 2026 rates.
